title: WPMS/1383/2017 of Bikram Singh Pundir Vs Chairman Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition M/S No.1383 of 2017
Shri Bikram Singh Pundir
 ÖÖPetitioner
 Versus
Chairman, Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority &
Others
 ÖÖ..Respondents
Present:-
 Mr. Bhuwan Bhatt, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. V.D. Bisen, Standing Counsel for the State/respondent No.1.
 Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate for respondent Nos. 2, 3 and 4.
 Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate for respondent No. 5.

Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
 Respondent No.5 has made an unauthorized
construction at Indirapuram Colony, GMS Road,
Dehradun. Admittedly, the place where the construction
has been made comes under the development area under
the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and Development Act,
1973 and there is a Development Authority existing which
is known as Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority
(in short ìMDDAî). Admittedly, no construction can be
made in the development area without the prior valid
permission of the Development Authority i.e. MDDA.
2. The respondent no. 5 has purchased two
floors i.e. ground floor and first floor, which constitute the
total structure of the building. Thereafter, the private
respondent no.5 has changed the structure of the building
by uplifting the entire structure by 4 feet, according to the
petitioner, by means of hydraulic jacks.

2
3. Learned counsel for respondent no. 5
submits that no commercial activities are taking place.
4. In view of this Court, such a construction
was not only unauthorized under the law but more
importantly, respondent no. 5 was also doing commercial
activities, though the building was for residential
purposes.
5. On a complaint moved by the petitioner, the
construction made by respondent no.5 was ordered to be
sealed by MDDA vide order dated 04.03.2017. Respondent
no.5 challenged the sealing order dated 04.03.2017 in an
appeal before the Chairman, MDDA, Dehradun. The
appeal so filed by the respondent no. 5 was disposed of by
the Chairman, MDDA vide order dated 07.03.2017 with
the direction that in case respondent no. 5 wants to get
the construction compounded, he is free to submit a
compounding map, and liberty was also granted to MDDA
to compound the same. Aggrieved, the petitioner has filed
the present writ petition before this Court challenging the
order dated 07.03.2017.
6. Learned counsel for MDDA submits that
there are certain unauthorized constructions which can be
compounded, but certain structures cannot be
compounded at all. The kind of unauthorized construction
respondent no. 5 has made falls in the latter category.
Consequently, the unauthorized construction made by
respondent no. 5 is not compoundable.
7. In view of the above position, the Appellate
Authority had no jurisdiction or authority to order for

3
compounding of a structure, which is not compoundable
in law. The order is an illegal order.
8. Consequently, the writ petition is allowed.
Order dated 07.03.2017 passed by respondent no. 1 is
hereby quashed and set aside. MDDA shall ensure that the
portion of the structure which is not compoundable is
demolished forthwith.
